name: N.E.K.O. desktop workbench
policy: Fixed snapshot. No automatic synchronization with the actively developed local UI. Parallel opt-in app with separate state from apps/desktop.
adapted: community-config.cjs / workbench-preload.cjs (existing NEKO community in isolated coding-pane WebContentsView)
main-chat-runtime.cjs / main-chat-secret.cjs / main-chat-ui.js (shared chat service assembly and scoped memory UI)
chat-routing.cjs / neko-chat.cjs (exclusive backends and cancellation generation)
pet-chat-presentation.js / renderer.js / original/feedback.js (persistent API replies and error precedence)
task-session-tracker.cjs / bridge.cjs (native human task sessions and exact-owner job cancellation)
task-pets.cjs / pet-layout.cjs / pet-roster.cjs (three tiers, identity revalidation, expiry and bounded rotation)
main.cjs / renderer.js / preload.cjs / style.css (task pets and native session navigation)
pet-appearance.js / assets/neko-cat/ (optional native cat media, source hashes and Apache license)
main.cjs / renderer.js / index.html / style.css (per-tier defaults and per-actor appearance switching)
assets/ai-girls/ (fywdy/chatgpt-chibi-pets fixed multi-frame animation WebP, CC BY-NC 4.0, source manifest)
pet-appearance.js / pet-appearance-import.cjs / pet-image-decoder.cjs (all-role animated appearances, isolated local decoding and per-role sizes)
assets/pixel-ai-girls/ (DSH-Pixel-Toons fixed packs, lossless eight-frame animation conversion and original license/notices)
fish-care.cjs / vendor/dsh-bili-whale / main.cjs (bundled pinned fish tools, explicit start/pause, in-workbench settings, isolated profile and read-only defaults)
verification: Offline unit and syntax checks only; no real DSH, N.E.K.O., account or model request is implied.
